meta.title: Nudge — Annotate & Tune on Any Page
meta.description: Point at any element in the right-sidebar browser, leave a note for the AI to fix it, or tweak styles and text yourself — changes are written back to your source files automatically.

toolbar.addressPlaceholder: Enter a web address (HTTP or HTTPS)

mode.browseHint: Browse: the page behaves normally. Switch to Annotate or Edit to start inspecting elements.
mode.annotateHint: Annotate: click an element, drag a region or select text, then write what you want the AI to change. Hold Space to use the page.
mode.editHint: Edit: click an element to open the style card and adjust text, colors, spacing and layout live. Hold Space to use the page.

dock.selectHint: Click an element on the page to start.
dock.syncHostStale: The UI and the plugin backend are different versions: quit DSH completely, reopen it, and retry.
dock.noDirectText: This element has no text you can edit directly
dock.structureUndoDone: Undone and written back to the source
dock.structureUndoTruncated: The element was too large (over 64 KB) and got cut: the page is restored, but the source was not written back; adjust the source manually.

annotation.statusDiscardArmed: Click again to discard all annotations
annotation.designDeleteHint: Remove this element and everything inside it

address.invalid: That address is invalid or too long.
address.protocol: Only HTTP and HTTPS addresses are supported.
address.credentials: Addresses cannot contain a username or password.
address.loadFailed: The page could not load; reload and try again.

source.reasonUnresolved: No matching element in the source
source.reasonAmbiguous: Several similar elements — cannot tell which one
source.reasonPathMismatch: The page structure changed; the element no longer lines up
source.reasonProtected: This is the page skeleton (html / body) and cannot be deleted or moved; pick an element inside it.
source.reasonTargetParent: The container to drop into is not in the source (the page differs from the source or was rendered by JS); pick a stabler container, or reload and retry.
source.reasonTargetAnchor: The insertion point is missing or duplicated in the source; drop next to something with an id or class.
source.reasonInvalidMove: The drop point conflicts with the source structure (the reference element is not inside the target container); try another drop target.
source.reasonUnsupportedParent: The target cannot hold children (script / textarea or a self-closing tag); pick a normal container.
source.reasonJsSource: This part comes from JS / JSX / TSX code; changing it automatically would break the code, so it stays preview-only. Edit styles or text instead.
source.reasonStaleHandle: The source changed outside Nudge, so the last position is stale; try again and it will re-locate.
source.reasonTooLarge: The source file is too large to write safely; work in a smaller file.
source.reasonNoMapping: This page has no matching source file in the workspace; put the page into the workspace to edit it.
source.reasonUnsupportedKind: The page and the plugin backend are different versions (usually DSH was not fully restarted after a small change); quit DSH completely, reopen it, and retry.
source.reasonUnsupportedSource: This kind of edit does not support the file type (for example, a structural edit in JS / TSX); edit styles or text, or work on an .html / .vue / .svelte page.
source.reasonInvalidEdit: The edit data was incomplete, so the plugin backend could not run it; select the element again and retry.
source.reasonMissingFile: The matching source file is gone (it may have been renamed or deleted); refresh the workspace and retry.
source.reasonIoFailed: Could not read or write the source file; check file permissions, then retry.
source.reasonStaleVersion: The source changed before the write, so this write was skipped; retry once.
source.reasonInternal: The plugin backend hit an internal error and nothing was written; retry, and report the log if it keeps happening.
source.reasonReadOnly: This session is read-only, so changes stay a preview; edit in a writable session.
source.noMapping: This page has no matching source file, so changes are preview-only.
source.notWritable: This session cannot write to the workspace, so changes stay a preview.
source.failed: Could not write back to source: {message}

settings.title: Nudge
settings.productIntro: Product preferences for Nudge. Changes apply as soon as you save.
settings.languageHint: Follow DSH uses the app language; picking one only changes Nudge’s own UI text.
settings.featureAnnotateHint: Hide the Annotate toggle; a page that is annotating returns to Browse.
settings.featureEditHint: Hide the Edit toggle that opens live style and text editing.
settings.featureDomTreeHint: Show the page structure (element hierarchy) entry next to the page.
settings.featureWorkspaceVersionsHint: Show the workspace files, history and commit panel entry.
settings.featureHotReloadHint: Reload the page when workspace files change; turning this off stops auto reload.
settings.contextMenuLinkHint: Show "Open in Nudge" on link right-click menus (including chat links).
settings.contextMenuTabHint: Show "Open in Nudge" in the browser tab ⋮ menu.
settings.aboutGitUnavailable: The plugin folder is not under version control
settings.updateUnavailable: This is a local development build and cannot update online
settings.updateHint: Development builds do not auto-update. Market-installed releases are checked at startup; restart DSH after updating.
settings.updateProgress: Downloading and installing the new version…
settings.readOnly: This environment does not allow saving settings here; the values below are the current active ones and are read-only.
settings.reloadHint: If the plugin was just updated, restart the app (or turn Nudge off and on in settings).
settings.featureFloatingComposerHint: Keep the chat box floating above the right panel while Nudge is fullscreen, so you can annotate and message at the same time.
settings.hotkeyHint: Single keys only fire inside the inspected page and never while typing in a field; changes apply immediately.
settings.hotkeyConflict: This key is already used by another shortcut
settings.hotkeyScopeHint: "Open Nudge / Page structure / Workspace versions" are app-level commands; change them in DSH Settings → Keyboard shortcuts.
